summary: PocketBase is a compact, single-file backend designed to support web applications and mobile apps. Written in Go and released under the MIT licence, it provides core backend services in a unified binary.
goodFor: Developers building lightweight SaaS products or mobile applications who want to avoid managing complex multi-service backend architectures.
watchOut: The all-in-one approach may lead to scaling limitations or tight coupling as your application logic and data models grow significantly more complex.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure persistent storage for the single-file database and place the application behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
